name: Central Arch Station Grand Roof
pivot: Y-up conversion of Z-up source. GLB world origin at ground station center, front towards positive glTF Z
masterplan_fit: NOT verified; position and yaw must be set in-engine against masterplan P03/D13
materials: embedded glTF metallic/roughness PBR with normal and ORM maps, 512/1024 base resolution
geometry_construction: Actual editable and named meshes; vertex UVs, face triangles, material assignments, glTF hierarchy
engine_setup: RAIL-01_Godot4.tscn with 48 simplified BoxShape3D colliders (not run in Godot)

reference_features.main_steel_arch_vault: double-chord steel I sections, diagonals, rivets, longitudinal bracing
reference_features.ten_side_arcade_bays: separate full-height curtain-wall arches with curved scalloped roofs
reference_features.facade: deep end-gable truss, vertical curtain wall grid, glass entrance canopy
reference_features.masonry: end pier towers with ashlar banding, quoins, window trims, side wings
reference_features.platforms: four railway track pairs, five boarding surfaces, tactile paving, benches, gallery balustrades
reference_features.details: glazing clamps, truss splices and fasteners, ridge ventilation, eave gutters, downpipes, column footings

remaining_variances: Not proven pixel/geometry identical to artistic collage; roof/facade interpretation is parametric
No native .blend delivered because Blender not available
Rear service doors are closed visual panels against solid wall; not navigable
Collision is proxy-only and requires interactive fit/walk QA in Godot
Structure is concept art, not engineering analysis or permit-ready design
